item.title: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation Director Makes Announces Big Changes to Hard Mode
item.description: Skilled players who welcome a challenge will often crank up the difficulty when starting a game for the first time. This wasn't possible in Final Fantasy 7 Remake and Rebirth , as fans would have to finish the game in order to unlock a greater difficulty mode. But things will be different in Final Fantasy 7 Revelation , according to series director Naoki Hamaguchi.

item.title: 5 Essential Horror Books You Need To Read At Least Once In Your Life
item.description: Horror books also challenge problematic societal norms and help cultivate empathy for extreme situations. To that end, there is no dearth of horror classics essential to our understanding of the genre. Even so, here are five essential horror books — meant to appeal to a range of genre sensibilities — that you must read at least once in your life. Why not start now?

item.title: The 7 Best Daily Pokémon Games, Ranked
item.description: Ever since Wordle exploded in popularity at the turn of the decade, all manner of daily puzzle games have followed suit, including plenty with a Pokémon theme. From guessing the Pokémon based on its color palette and playing Pokémon-themed sudoku to daily battles against the iconic Red, there are loads of options for every budding trainer.

item.title: One of 2026's Best Horror Movies Is Officially Headed to Netflix Soon
item.description: Obsession 's theatrical run is over, which means fans who want to experience the 2026 horror hit again, or maybe for the first time, have to look to digital platforms to watch it. In November, director Curry Barker's Obsession will make its debut on Netflix, which is bound to spark another surge of discussion about the horror film.

item.title: 28 Years Ago, a Near-Perfect Zombie Thriller Resurrected a Beloved Franchise From the Dead
item.description: For the past few years, Scooby-Doo media has been met with either cool indifference (e.g., Scooby-Doo and Guess Who ?) or outright hostility ( Velma ). So fans of the lovable hound and Mystery Incorporated are likely hedging their bets that Netflix’s upcoming 2027 adaptation, Scooby-Doo: Origins , will bring something new and exciting to the franchise.

item.title: 9 Years Later, The Simpsons' Controversial Character Officially Returns
item.description: In January 2020, Hank Azaria stepped down from voicing one of the most iconic characters on The Simpsons , Kwik-E-Mart owner Apu Nahasapeemapetilon. The actor and the show's writers agreed that the portrayal of Apu was charged with racial stereotypes, and they apologized while the character and his family were quietly moved to the background of the show. On Oct. 18, 2026, in the season 38 episode "The Revengening," Apu officially returned to The Simpsons with a new voice actor.

item.title: Tom Cruise's 10/10 War Action Epic Is About to Say Goodbye to HBO Max
item.description: Tom Cruise has built a career out of playing larger-than-life characters, but some of his best performances are when he delves into the more vulnerable people beneath the movie-star bravado. Days of Thunder filters the story of a hotshot NASCAR driver through the humbling process of learning to trust someone, while Jerry Maguire finds a sports agent in the throes of learning that success means little without genuine human connection. Even Tropic Thunder , for all its outrageous comedy, gives Cruise room to disappear into a grotesque Hollywood executive whose insecurities are as ridiculous as his explosive temper. And Alejandro González Iñárritu’s Digger gives Cruise one of his most fascinating character studies yet as an oil tycoon with a brazen plan to save the world.

item.title: 31 Years Later, Calvin and Hobbes' Scariest Comic Is Still a Controversial Classic
item.description: On a Halloween reread of Bill Watterson's Calvin and Hobbes , one of its more remarkable qualities is that it usually doesn't bother with that. There are a few seasonal strips and arcs scattered across its nine-year run, sure, and Calvin's struggle with staying good before Christmas is an annual tradition. But as a whole, C&H is less concerned with the holiday calendar than one might expect, particularly in its late, post- sabbatical era.
